questions.text: Which fruit is the main ingredient of guacamole?
questions.explanation: Guacamole is made by mashing avocados.

questions.text: What is the main ingredient of hummus?
questions.explanation: Hummus is blended from chickpeas and tahini.

questions.text: Which country is the home of the rice dish paella?
Which cheese is traditionally crumbled over a Greek salad?
questions.explanation: Feta is the classic Greek salad cheese.

questions.text: Which spirit is made from the blue agave plant?
questions.explanation: Tequila is distilled from blue agave.

questions.text: Which expensive spice comes from the stigmas of a crocus flower?
questions.explanation: Saffron threads are the dried stigmas of Crocus sativus.

questions.text: Which pasta, whose name means "little ears", is shaped like small bowls?
questions.explanation: Orecchiette comes from the Italian for little ears.

questions.text: Which nut is the main ingredient of marzipan?
questions.explanation: Marzipan is made from ground almonds and sugar.

questions.text: Which fruit is dried to make prunes?
Which vegetable is the most common base of Korean kimchi?
questions.explanation: Napa cabbage is the standard base for kimchi.

questions.text: Which French sauce is made from egg yolks, butter and lemon juice?
questions.explanation: Hollandaise is an emulsion of yolks, butter and lemon.

questions.text: Which Italian dessert's name translates as "pick me up"?
questions.explanation: Tiramisu literally means pick me up.

questions.text: Which fish's eggs provide authentic caviar?
Sherry takes its English name from which Spanish town?
questions.explanation: Sherry is an anglicisation of Jerez.

questions.text: Which Japanese chemist identified the taste of umami in 1908 from kombu seaweed broth?
questions.explanation: Ikeda isolated glutamate as the source of umami.

spares.text: Which dairy product is churned to make butter?
spares.explanation: Churning separates cream into butter and buttermilk.

spares.text: Which tea is flavoured with oil from the bergamot orange?
spares.explanation: Earl Grey is scented with bergamot.

spares.text: In which English county is the village that gave Cheddar cheese its name?
